critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the existing window row primitive along the fuselage to create two distinct horizontal rows. Adjust the vertical offset of the new row by 15% of the cabin height and ensure both rows maintain a uniform spacing of 20 units between individual windows, while introducing 40-unit gaps at specific intervals to accommodate door placements.
